subject: GCP Marketplace onboarding & procurement sprint — next steps
messages:
From: Sarah Li <sarah@alfacloud.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@alfacloud.com
Date: 2027-04-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: GCP Marketplace onboarding & procurement sprint — next steps

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We’re excited to move forward with a GCP Marketplace listing for AlfaCloud’s managed observability addon. Procurement asked me to line up the onboarding and a short procurement sprint so we can get the seller registration and billing path validated.

High-level ask: can we lock a two-week sprint (starting next Mon) that covers:
- Contract review / PO and billing mapping
- GCP seller registration and listing artifacts
- Billing SKU mapping + test purchase flow
- Go-live checklist and co-sell enablement touchpoints

I’ve cc’d procurement so you have their direct contact. I’ll attach the PO template and internal checklist in a follow-up.

Thanks,
Sarah Li
Senior Partnerships Manager
AlfaCloud
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah@alfacloud.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace onboarding & procurement sprint — next steps

Sarah —

Appreciate the clear plan. We can run a focused onboarding sprint starting Monday (2027-04-19). Proposed owner map and milestone targets:
- Contract & PO: Kimberly Park (legal & billing) — target 4/21
- Seller artifacts & listing bundle: Vanessa Ortiz (partner ops) — target 4/23
- Billing SKU mapping + test purchase: Finance (Mina Haddad) — test by 4/26
- Final go/no-go for submit: 4/28

Action items for you before kickoff:
1) Share the PO template (procurement contact already cc’d)
2) Confirm primary technical contact for listing artifacts (AMI/container owners)
3) Any special billing terms or reseller codes AlfaCloud expects

I’ll loop in Finance and Partner Ops internally. If that timeline works I’ll send a short sprint calendar and standing 30m daily sync for the week of 4/19.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Manager, Marketplaces

Forwarding the ask from AlfaCloud — they want a short procurement sprint starting 4/19. Please see the bullets below (copied from Sarah).

Quick asks from our side:
- Kimberly: can you confirm ballpark contract/po redline turnaround (we should aim to have redlines by 4/21). Also will need billing contact for mapping invoices.
- Vanessa: will you lead the listing bundle (artifacts, screenshots, test account) and confirm what we need from their engineers?
- Mina: can Finance own the SKU mapping test purchase and confirm expected settlement cadence for GCP Marketplace purchases?

Proposed daily sync: Mon-Fri 4/19–4/23 at 10:00 PT (30 mins). I’ll create the calendar and invite stakeholders.

Thanks — Karthik
